Analysis Methodology

This insider trading detection system uses multiple machine learning techniques:

  • Isolation Forest: Detects anomalous trading patterns
  • Random Forest Classifier: Classifies trades as suspicious or normal
  • Feature Engineering: Creates 8 different anomaly scores

Features Analyzed:

  • Trade Size Anomaly - Unusual trade amounts for the senator
  • Timing Anomaly - Trades on unusual days/times
  • Frequency Anomaly - Unusual trading frequency
  • Sector Concentration - Over-concentration in specific sectors
  • Committee Relevance - Trading stocks related to their committees
  • Market Timing - Trades before major market events
  • Performance Anomaly - Unusually profitable trades
  • Behavioral Change - Changes in trading patterns
